messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — I'm migrating the weekly performance dashboard db to the new event schema tonight at 11pm PT. Expect ~1–2hr lag on KPIs and auto-email disabled. @Alex @Jamal can you hold off on sharing the snapshot until Monday? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex: Thanks — noted. Does this change affect attribution windows? We saw a mismatch on last webinar leads vs SFDC yesterday.
Priya: Yes, attribution keys change (session_id -> anon_id). I'm running a mapping job; should preserve UTM joins. Will post mapping table.
Jamal: Can you run the webinar lead reconciliation after migration? The lead count was ~1200 in dashboard vs 980 in inbound pipeline.
Casey: I'm seeing failures in the dashboard job locally when I test the new schema — `NULL` on `converted_at` moments. Pasting small query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE name='lead' AND converted_at IS NOT NULL;
```
Priya: Good catch Casey. The ETL dropped `converted_at` for legacy records. Fixing now, re-ingesting historical slice (last 90 days).
marketing-bot: deploy scheduled: dataset-migration v2 starting at 2024-06-12T06:00Z
Alex: After the migration, can we run the reconciliation steps? I can run the `lead_recon` notebook — need the mapping file path.
Priya: Mapping file will be at s3://redwood-marketing/mapping/utm_session_to_anon_1717777777.csv once job completes.
Jamal: I'll run the notebook once the file is there. Also flagging a potential attribution split by `utm_source` — some sources have truncated params.
Casey: Screenshot of the failure log: https://imgur.com/a/abcd1234 (shows `converted_at` nulls)
Priya: Update — re-ingest done for last 90 days, migration completed, re-enabled auto-email at 12:40am PT. 
Alex: Ran `lead_recon` — counts now: dashboard 1188, pipeline 1176. Narrowed gap to 12; looks like delayed SFDC ingest for 9 leads. :thumbsup:
Jamal: Good. I'll run a quick cohort diff and post any surprises.
Priya: Post-mortem notes: (1) Add a pre-migration smoke test to validate `converted_at` non-null for sample slice; (2) Add mapping verification script to CI; (3) Delay weekly auto-email 2 hours after migration window. I've created a ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PM-3816
Alex: Thanks — can we add a dashboard alert if lead delta > 5%?
Priya: Yup will add threshold alert and small runbook. Closing thread for now — reach out if anything else pops up. :slightly_smiling_face:
